notes: A RowSafe account and the separate hosted service are required.
Remote Streamable HTTP supports OAuth 2.1 or a RowSafe API key in the Authorization: Bearer header.
For stdio, install the CLI using https://rowsafe.sh/docs/reference/cli#install and run rowsafe login before launching rowsafe mcp. ROWSAFE_API_KEY is an alternative to the saved CLI login.
The stdio command is read-only by default; --allow-restore-points or --allow-writes enables additional tools. Remote permissions depend on the connected app or API key.

Metadata is based on public RowSafe documentation: https://rowsafe.sh/docs/reference/mcp and https://rowsafe.sh/docs/reference/cli, and source: https://github.com/rowsafe/rowsafe/blob/main/cmd/rowsafe/mcp.go.
This metadata update does not verify remote endpoint health or claim TensorBlock verification.
Apache-2.0 applies to the agent, CLI and MCP server; the hosted service is separate.
